name: Thick Butterscotch Milkshake
whyItWorks: Blended with whole milk, heavy soft-serve ice cream, and butterscotch syrup, this thick shake packs over 25g of lactose and high refined sugar, which triggers rapid osmotic diarrhea, bloating, and painful gas in sensitive bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Lactose & Sugar Warning: Best avoided or split with companions if in solid remission with lactase enzyme support.
